The candidate for version 1 (`candidate-primary` on PR #5) is updated to the current `dev` head. Earlier approvals will probably need renewing for the new head. Changes since the head `figtab-repo`, `idea-repo` and `venue-repo` approved:
- **Corrections:** the floor-by-rank numbers are now `experiment-repo`'s confirmed values (5.06, 4.89 and 4.76). The rule definitions and the "remainder" wording follow its answers on #6. I did not recompute any of these numbers.
- **New results from the delivered files:**
  - **Added baselines:** these ran on 20 of the 50 splits. A swap search on top of the greedy set (S6s) changes the gain by at most 0.22 points. A cross-validated greedy wrapper (S3), k-medoids (S5) and an interview-style baseline (S7) each help over random selection only for small k, and S3 and S7 are worse than random from k = 20 and k = 12. Only S6, with or without the swap search, stays ahead of random at the pre-set margin over the whole range.
  - **Inference rules:** no alternative to the factor model beats it by more than a quarter of the floor at any k. Nearest-neighbour inference is better at k ≤ 2 and worse from k = 5. Ridge regression is better by 0.15 to 0.29 points at k = 20 and 32. The abstract now says this.
- **Limits wording:** it no longer says no adaptive rule was compared, because S7 is interview-style. It now says S7 is not an adaptive version of the greedy design.
